row.evidence: The pricing page only offers custom quotes ("Pick your plan to get a custom quote") and the security practices page says SSO is supported "for Enterprise customers"; no Talkwalker page mentions SCIM or user provisioning.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only: Core, Analyze and Business plans, all with unlimited users and custom quotes. Product now sold as Lumen by Talkwalker. SSO is for Enterprise customers per the security page; no SCIM documentation found on the marketing site, sitemap or developer API docs, but the help centre could not be loaded, so status stays unknown rather than none. Public API is a credit-metered data API with no user management.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Card lists 'enterprise features and governance'; the security page says SSO is for Enterprise customers, but no plan is named Enterprise.

limitations.text: The public Talkwalker API (developer.talkwalker.com) covers search, streaming, documents, topics, panels, images and credits; tokens are issued by the CSM and metered in credits. No user-management endpoints appear in its sitemap.

entra.notes: No Talkwalker entry in the Entra saas-apps toc.yml.

fallbacks.notes: Help centre (helpcenter.talkwalker.com, Salesforce community) redirects and returns 401 to its sitemap and search API; could not be read.
